scope: Bounded 2023–2026 research search and selected primary-text reading; not an exhaustive SOTA, patentability or freedom-to-operate search.

sources.title: Maximizing wireless power transfer efficiency at exceptional points (2025)
sources.readingDepth: Selected full-text sections read: Abstract, Results: exceptional point and maximum efficiency; Conclusions; selected coupled-mode model paragraphs
sources.section: Abstract, Results: exceptional point and maximum efficiency; Conclusions; selected coupled-mode model paragraphs
sources.finding: The authors propose adaptive virtual-load loss adjustment in an active parity-time-symmetric WPT system; source gain and receiver losses are explicit.
sources.limit: This active converter system is not the existing passive R1/R2 fixture. No efficiency, component value or hardware performance is transferred to this workbench.

sources.title: Deep room impulse response completion (2025)
sources.readingDepth: Selected full-text sections read: Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, Conclusion and data-availability paragraphs
sources.section: Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, Conclusion and data-availability paragraphs
sources.finding: DECOR predicts a late reverberation tail from an early room impulse response; the authors report degraded performance on an unseen dataset.
sources.limit: A predicted tail is synthetic. It cannot recover a unique monument geometry, material response or historical sound without independent measurements.

sources.title: US20260246304A1 - Systems and Methods for Dynamically Tuning a Wireless Power Transfer System
sources.kind: published patent application; legal status not assessed
sources.readingDepth: Abstract and claim1 read; selected controller-description context
sources.finding: The application describes jointly configurable drive frequency, supply voltage and a capacitor bank under transmitter control.
sources.limit: Published application text is a proposal, not independent validation. Its controller/converter cannot be substituted into the fixed passive source model or treated as permission to manufacture.

sources.title: US20260233630A1 - Method and system for metering electricity transmitted to electric vehicles over a wireless power transfer system
sources.kind: published patent application; legal status not assessed
sources.readingDepth: Abstract and claims1–5 read; selected field/background definitions
sources.finding: The application separates management-unit energy input and per-transmitter distribution for energy metering.
sources.limit: Road/vehicle accounting is a different system boundary; current-only allocation is not sufficient proof of full phase-aware receiver energy in this bench.

sources.title: US20260229927A1 - Dynamic control of wireless power for a variable load
sources.kind: published patent application; legal status not assessed
sources.readingDepth: Abstract and claims1–8 read; selected technical-field context
sources.finding: The application describes reference load states, feedback, coupling-factor references and synchronization of control changes.
sources.limit: A communication/control proposal does not establish a calibrated coupling factor, stable closed-loop operation or improved efficiency in this fixture.

sources.title: US20240029705A1 - Acoustic levitation system, computer-implemented method for levitating an object, computer program and non-volatile data carrier
sources.kind: published patent application; legal status not assessed
sources.readingDepth: Abstract read; selected claim1 and description-of-figures context
sources.finding: The application describes phased acoustic transducer elements and a reflector-relative standing-wave arrangement.
sources.limit: This is a separate ultrasonic hardware proposal, not an effect produced by phone audio, a monument image or the current audible sonification. No operating power, exposure limit or compatible hardware is established here.

improvements.title: Compare coupling and load robustness before adaptive control
improvements.proposal: Record a calibrated baseline across coil placement and receiving load. Evaluate an adaptive-load candidate as a separate design branch with its converter and controller power inside the energy boundary.
improvements.rationale: The 2025 primary paper makes source gain and receiver loss explicit; its active PT model motivates a controlled comparison rather than silently modifying the passive source fixture.
requiredValidation: Keep source R1/R2 peak-voltage values unchanged in the baseline.
Characterize actual self/mutual inductance and phase-aware sensing at each geometry.
Include every controller/drive/auxiliary supply, load heat, winding loss and endpoint storage in the energy account.
Predefine comparable operating points, uncertainties and pass/fail criteria before a new hardware branch.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Evaluate synthetic late reverberation separately from measured room response
improvements.proposal: Retain the raw measured response and deterministic early-reflection baseline. In a separate optional research branch, compare a predicted late tail with held-out measured rooms and clearly label all inferred samples.
improvements.rationale: The 2025 DECOR full-text discussion identifies unseen-room generalization losses. A modelled tail is useful for auralization while retaining the measurement and inference boundary.
requiredValidation: Review code/data licenses before any model import; no model is downloaded or added here.
Keep held-out rooms separate from training or tuning.
Record sampling rate, excitation, microphone calibration, source and receiver positions and processing.
Compare frequency-dependent decay and waveform/energy diagnostics against actual measured tails; report uncertainty and failure cases.
Do not label the predicted tail as a measured monument resonance or intrinsic material damping.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Log frequency, supply and tuning state as separate control variables
improvements.proposal: Define a separate controlled-excitation test branch whose experimental log records drive frequency, supply voltage, selected capacitor configuration and source power at each step.
improvements.rationale: A recent 2026 application distinguishes these control variables. Keeping them separately recorded prevents an apparent improvement caused by an unnoticed input-power change.
requiredValidation: Preserve the frozen source baseline and proposed branch as different revisions.
Document all switched capacitance ratings, transient limits and controller/converter auxiliary power before assembly.
Run fixed-load and fixed-source controls with calibrated simultaneous voltage/current acquisition.
Compare total energy and uncertainty, not receiver voltage alone.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Separate input, branch and load energy measurement boundaries
improvements.proposal: Create a commissioning worksheet with independently identified input, transfer-branch and receiving-load energy channels, signed polarity and start/end storage states.
improvements.rationale: The 2026 application explicitly distinguishes input and distributed energy accounting. The transferable research question is boundary completeness; its road-metering implementation is not adopted.
requiredValidation: Calibrate each voltage/current channel including phase and clock alignment.
Include internal loss, external supports/auxiliary sources and endpoint stored energy.
Compare an independent energy quadrature with the original solver accounting.
Do not equate current allocation with measured load energy without the corresponding voltage and phase.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Test load-state transition timing and feedback delay
improvements.proposal: Preregister a test for whether load changes, acquisition timing or delayed feedback can create apparent power-gain peaks; keep fixed-state baselines and state-transition receipts.
improvements.rationale: The 2026 application identifies load states, coupling references and synchronization. They motivate controls for transient artifacts before any adaptive control is added.
requiredValidation: Log the exact source, load and feedback state against a shared clock.
Compare delayed and exchanged-channel controls.
Measure rather than infer coupling from gap or a product name.
Record every drive/controller supply and validate stability before a hardware fork.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated

improvements.title: Keep ultrasonic trapping as a separately specified experimental branch
improvements.proposal: If acoustic manipulation is investigated, create a separate transducer/controller/reflector specification and position-calibration protocol rather than interpreting a phone or image-mapped pitch as a trapping field.
improvements.rationale: The 2024 application is an explicit controlled phase-and-reflector proposal. It identifies why the current audible mixed-recording setup cannot itself establish levitation.
requiredValidation: Obtain an actual transducer, drive, geometry and exposure specification before a hardware procedure.
Define calibrated position/force observations and ordinary mechanical/acoustic alternatives.
Retain source-only, reflector-position and object-removed controls.
No ultrasonic drive instructions, exposure limits or claimed trapping performance are supplied by this documentation.
improvements.status: proposed research improvement; not implemented or physically validated
